backend/teaching.py.purpose: Owner-private demonstration teaching: capture collection, encrypted evidence/draft revisions, bounded vision draft generation, task-scoped candidate tests and native skill publication.
responsibilities: Define 19 owner-authenticated teaching routes under /api/v1/bots/{bot_id}/teaching plus the /teaching-private-input barrier (router-level Depends(owner)).

Create at most one active (preparing/recording/paused/finalizing) recording per bot, bound to the owner viewer hash and the current desktop lease epoch, only when the caller holds input-ready control.
Relay capture control actions (start/pause/private/resume/finish/discard) to the runtime adapter with a monotonically increasing capture_revision and an expected owner revision.
Provide a repeatable private-input barrier that pauses capture before Secure input typing and records an omitted marker.

Collect volatile runtime capture batches (ack-based), encrypt them with Fernet, stage them in the MinIO bucket, read them back, then commit a chunk manifest and advance last_seq; mark sessions interrupted when the runtime collector no longer holds the session.
Advertise 'ready' only after the full sealed tail is persisted and the runtime capture revision matches.
Serve decrypted timeline events (without images), a derived step summary and individual JPEG frames for owner review.
Freeze owner-reviewed evidence (text plus at most 12 selected frames, <=6 MiB) as an encrypted, hashed, immutable revision.

Queue and run one workspace-wide generation job at a time: send a random vision canary plus reviewed evidence to the bot's OpenAI-compatible provider, verify image support, validate SKILL.md output, bounded repair, fence late results by job token and evidence hash.
Save owner-edited drafts with strict hermbot-* name and YAML frontmatter validation and keep draft history.
Create candidate test tasks in the bot's DM conversation and bind them to evidence hash, draft hash, encrypted candidate copy and a material configuration hash.
Expose the candidate only to its own test task (candidate()), fence it when configuration changes and mark consultation.
Record owner verification of a completed, consulted test.

Publish only the current, consulted, owner-verified candidate through knowledge.guard/knowledge.apply (native CAS, knowledge_versions, configuration refresh) with a native readback hash check and a provenance row.
Toggle retention pinning, delete sessions (stopping active candidate tests), expire unpinned sessions after expires_at, purge private objects/chunks/revisions and scrub encrypted test data.
Garbage-collect unreferenced staged objects under teaching/ at most once per minute.
Run the maintain and generate_one loops every second inside the worker process.

notes.text: Routes are registered before the generic product router so /bots/{bot_id}/{action} cannot swallow /teaching (review finding).
All private payloads use Fernet (CONFIG_ENCRYPTION_KEY) both in PostgreSQL columns and MinIO objects.
Collector state changes (paused/ready from batches) do not bump the owner-facing revision; only the collector-restart path does.

control() performs the runtime call inside the DB transaction that holds the session row lock and the owner_receipts advisory lock; a retried key replays at the runtime via same-revision/same-action idempotency.

docker/teaching_capture.py.purpose: Volatile in-runtime observer of accepted RFB client bytes plus the bounded per-container capture buffer; never authorizes input.
responsibilities: Parse accepted client-to-server RFB bytes across arbitrary fragmentation (skip 14-byte handshake; SetPixelFormat, SetEncodings, FramebufferUpdateRequest, KeyEvent, PointerEvent, ClientCutText, EnableContinuousUpdates, Fence, SetDesktopSize, QEMU extended key).
Emit semantic key/pointer events; replace clipboard and geometry-change messages with 'omitted' markers so clipboard payloads are never retained.
Raise on unknown message types/QEMU sub-types so the adapter pauses capture instead of guessing.
Hold one recording per runtime: session, viewer, epoch, state, reason, revision, generation, seq, buffer and byte counters under an RLock.
Apply revision-fenced, idempotent control actions; reject other-session or other-viewer/epoch actions except finish/discard.
Bump generation on every transition/pause so late frames from an earlier generation are dropped.
Append events with monotonically increasing seq, generation and monotonic time; pause at 8 MiB unacknowledged or 256 MiB total.
Only observe input while recording, from the bound viewer/epoch, and while the collector has polled within 15 s; coalesce unpressed pointer moves; request a keyframe at most every 0.5 s.
Validate frames (<=2 MiB decoded, Pillow-read dimensions) and append them only for the current generation while recording.
Pause on disconnect of the bound viewer only.
Serve ack-based batches (~3 MiB) and refresh the liveness heartbeat only on idle or acknowledged progress.

notes.text: segment is incremented when geometry changes but never written into events; and the adapter passes capture.geometry itself as the geometry argument, so the comparison never differs.
After the parser raises, its buffer keeps the unparseable bytes, so every later feed on that WebSocket raises again and capture re-pauses until reconnect.

states.name: preparing
states.desc: Created after input-ready takeover; no runtime collector yet (capture_revision 0).

states.name: recording
states.desc: Runtime capture accepts input/frames from the bound viewer/epoch.

states.name: paused
states.desc: Explicit pause, private barrier, handback/takeover, disconnect, lost persistence heartbeat, storage limit, unsupported input or frame failure.

states.name: finalizing
states.desc: Finish sent; collector draining the sealed tail.

states.name: ready
states.desc: Entire tail persisted; evidence review allowed.

states.name: interrupted
states.desc: Runtime collector no longer holds the session (restart); retained prefix reviewable.

states.name: discarded
states.desc: Owner discarded during capture; maintain() purges it like a delete.

states.name: deleting
states.desc: Owner delete or expiry; tests cancelled; purge pending/retrying.

states.name: deleted
states.desc: Tombstone: objects, chunks, revisions removed; info/evidence/draft cleared.

states.name: failed
states.desc: Listed in expiry SQL and plan but never set by any code path (dead state).

transitions.trigger: collector persisted last event and capture revision matches (or empty batch)
control discard with capture_revision 0 (local, no runtime)
collector: batch session differs (runtime restarted) and capture_revision > 0
expiry: NOT pinned AND expires_at < now() (finalizing excluded)

state_machines.notes: Owner-facing revision increments on owner actions and collector-restart interruption only; collector state syncs are fenced by capture_revision. Unique partial index allows one active (preparing/recording/paused/finalizing) row per bot. No transition from any state is unconditional; 'deleting' is reachable from every state except finalizing/deleting/deleted.

states.name: (none)
states.desc: Fresh adapter process; no session.

states.name: paused
states.desc: Initial state of a newly started session (before revision 1 applies) and any pause.

states.name: recording
states.desc: Observing accepted input and frames.

states.name: ready
states.desc: Finished; batches continue until drained.

states.name: discarded
states.desc: Buffer cleared.

transitions.trigger: start for a new session resets buffer (rejected if another session is recording/paused)

states.name: idle
states.desc: Default; also after saving evidence or a draft.

states.name: queued
states.desc: Waiting for the single workspace generation slot.

states.name: running
states.desc: Provider call in progress (job_started_at set).

states.name: completed
states.desc: Draft stored and fenced by token/evidence hash.

states.name: failed
states.desc: Provider/validation error, vision check failure or >4 min stale.

states.name: cancelled
states.desc: Owner cancel, delete or expiry.

transitions.trigger: generate_one claims oldest queued ready/interrupted session if nothing running
valid output and job_token/evidence_hash/state still match
cancel-generation (from ANY job state, including idle/completed)
save evidence or save draft (clears job_token, fencing in-flight output)

states.name: created
states.desc: Task created in DM conversation; candidate visible only to this task.

states.name: consulted
states.desc: consulted_at stamped by skill_view consult or prepare.

states.name: completed
states.desc: tasks.status completed; reportable only if consulted.

states.name: verified_passed
states.desc: owner_passed true with encrypted observations.

states.name: verified_failed
states.desc: owner_passed false with observations.

states.name: stale
states.desc: draft/evidence/config hash no longer current (computed, not stored).

states.name: cancelled
states.desc: Task cancelled because source deleted/expired.

states.name: scrubbed
states.desc: Candidate/checks replaced with encrypted empty strings and report cleared after purge.

transitions.trigger: new evidence/draft save or config_hash change; candidate() raises 409

states.name: unpublished
states.desc: No row.

states.name: refresh_pending
states.desc: Native write verified by readback, knowledge version and configure operation recorded; runtime refresh tracked by sm:bot-operation.

transitions.trigger: POST publish (owner-verified current consulted test, guard, CAS, readback)
same idempotency key replays receipt; different key with same (session, draft, test) hits ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

state_machines.notes: Status 'refresh_pending' is a constant in the response, not a stored column.

features.title: Demonstration teaching (phase 6.2)
features.purpose: Lets the owner teach a teammate a reusable procedure by demonstrating it on the bot's private computer: capture accepted input and keyframes privately, review and freeze exact evidence, have the bot's vision model draft a SKILL.md, test that exact candidate on fresh inputs in an ordinary task without installing it, verify the actual result, and publish it as a versioned native skill.

logic.step: Owner takes over the computer; runtime pauses any capture, drains admitted tools and marks the viewer/epoch input-ready.
POST /teaching checks mine && input_ready via native GET /computer and inserts a 'preparing' session with viewer_hash, lease epoch and encrypted goal (idempotent, one active per bot).
Start/resume go to runtime /teaching/control with capture_revision+1; runtime re-checks readiness/epoch, sets recording and takes an initial keyframe.

Accepted RFB bytes (after the native RfbClientFilter) are parsed into key/pointer/omitted events and appended only while recording for the bound viewer/epoch and a fresh collector heartbeat; keyframes every >=0.5 s after input.
Secure input and panel close call the private barrier: runtime pauses, bumps generation (dropping late frames) and stores an 'omitted private step' marker before keys are sent.
Worker maintain loop collects batches every second: contiguous-seq check, Fernet encrypt, put to MinIO, read back, commit chunk + last_seq; collector restart => interrupted.
Finish sets finalizing; ready is set only once the last event is persisted and the capture revision matches.
Owner reviews timeline/steps and frames, edits text and selects <=12 frames; PUT evidence freezes an encrypted, hashed revision and resets any job.

Generate queues a job snapshotting provider id/revision/model/evidence_hash; generate_one runs one job workspace-wide, sends a vision canary plus evidence to /chat/completions, validates and stores the draft if still current.
Owner edits and saves the exact draft (strict name/frontmatter validation, draft history).
Owner hands back and runs a test: a DM task with fresh inputs/checks plus a teaching_tests row binding evidence/draft/config hashes.
During the test task the candidate appears as an enabled skill only for that task; skill_view/prepare fetch it through the backend and stamp consulted_at.
Owner records observations and pass/fail for the completed, consulted test.

Publish rechecks current hashes, consultation and owner pass, runs knowledge.guard/apply (native CAS, version, configure operation), verifies native readback and records provenance; response 'refresh_pending'.
Retention: unpinned sessions expire after 7 days; delete/expiry cancels tests, discards the runtime tail and purges objects, chunks, revisions and encrypted test data; orphan objects are GC'd.

data.text: teaching_sessions: owner revision, capture_revision, viewer_hash/epoch binding, state/reason, last_seq/retained_bytes, Fernet info/evidence/draft, evidence_hash/draft_hash/skill_name, job_state/job_token/job_started_at/job_provider, error, pinned, expires_at.
teaching_chunks: (session_id, first_seq) PK, last_seq, unique object_key, sha256 of plaintext, size.
teaching_revisions: (session_id, kind evidence|draft, sha256) PK, data_encrypted.
teaching_tests: task_id unique (cascade with tasks), evidence/draft/config hashes, candidate/checks/report encrypted, consulted_at, owner_passed.
teaching_publications: session/test/knowledge_version links plus evidence/draft hashes, UNIQUE(session_id, draft_hash, test_id).
MinIO bucket hermbot, prefix teaching/<session>/<first_seq>-<sha256>: Fernet ciphertext of JSON event arrays (frames as data URLs).
Touches tasks (test tasks, cancellation), knowledge_versions/bots/bot_operations (publish), owner_receipts (idempotency), providers (generation), conversations (DM).
Volatile runtime buffer: events with seq, generation, monotonic time, geometry; frames with image data URL, sha256 and dimensions.

decisions.decision: Record a structured action timeline plus selected keyframes, not continuous video.
decisions.why: Video is unnecessary to teach/inspect and adds storage/transcoding; keyframes plus events suffice.
decisions.alternatives: Continuous screen video; DOM/ARIA capture from the browser.
decisions.tradeoffs: Cheaper and reviewable, but frames are periodic snapshots (0.2 s after input, <=2/s) not proof of outcome; no DOM semantics.

decisions.decision: Observe the accepted RFB stream after the unchanged native RfbClientFilter, in a Hermbot-owned parser.
decisions.why: Only accepted input should be recorded; the native gate stays the security authority; WebSocket packets are not actions.
decisions.alternatives: Record in the browser/noVNC; patch the native filter; use a third-party recorder.
decisions.tradeoffs: Keeps Hermes unmodified, but the parser must track protocol details and raises (pauses) on unknown messages.

decisions.decision: Explicit server-acknowledged private-input barrier before Secure input typing; capture stays paused until explicit resume.
decisions.why: Secure input emits ordinary VNC keys that a recorder cannot distinguish; a frontend indicator is insufficient.
decisions.alternatives: Password-field detection in pixels; OCR redaction after capture.
decisions.tradeoffs: Reliable for the Secure input path only; secrets typed through the normal keyboard while recording are captured.

decisions.decision: Fence capture by viewer hash, lease epoch, revision and generation.
decisions.why: Prevent stale tabs/collectors or a new owner session from appending to an older recording and drop late frames across privacy transitions.
decisions.tradeoffs: A new takeover epoch or new login identity cannot resume the old session (finish/discard only).

decisions.decision: Volatile runtime buffer with ack-based durable collection by the worker; ready only after the sealed tail is persisted.
decisions.why: Avoid plaintext fallback in bot workspaces; database must not advertise missing chunks; liveness must reflect committed progress.
decisions.alternatives: Runtime writes directly to storage; push from runtime.
decisions.tradeoffs: Runtime restart loses the unacknowledged tail (interrupted); collector outage pauses recording after 15 s.

decisions.decision: Stage encrypted object, read it back, then commit manifest; GC unreferenced objects separately.
decisions.why: Dual-write safety: a manifest must never point at missing/corrupt data.
decisions.tradeoffs: Orphan objects possible until GC (24 h or session deletion).

decisions.decision: Application-level Fernet encryption (CONFIG_ENCRYPTION_KEY) for chunks and all private columns; not Library artifacts.
decisions.why: Keep recordings owner-private, outside automatic indexing/sharing.
decisions.alternatives: MinIO server-side encryption; Library artifacts with ACLs.
decisions.tradeoffs: Single workspace key; plaintext still exists in tasks.input for test prompts and in model provider requests.

decisions.decision: Owner freezes exact reviewed evidence; only that text and selected frames go to the provider.
decisions.why: OpenAdapt-style exact approved upload bytes; edits revoke prior processing/test binding.
decisions.alternatives: Send the whole recording; automatic redaction.
decisions.tradeoffs: Owner effort; frames may still contain secrets that review misses.

decisions.decision: Vision canary image with random colour bands, accepting 5/6 matches.
decisions.why: An OpenAI-compatible text endpoint does not prove image support; verify image processing without demanding perfect colour naming.
decisions.tradeoffs: Extra image per request; a lucky/partial reader passes; does not verify procedure accuracy.

decisions.decision: One generation job at a time for the workspace via advisory lock + running check.
decisions.why: Plan's proposed starting limit for the local workspace.
decisions.tradeoffs: Head-of-line blocking up to 120 s per job (4 min reaper).

decisions.decision: Task-scoped candidate exposed through capabilities + plugin middleware + backend consult, not by installing/enabling the skill.
decisions.why: Normal native skill reads use globally installed files; temporary installation would affect other tasks.
decisions.alternatives: Temporarily install candidate; paste draft into the prompt.
decisions.tradeoffs: Candidate content also travels in the capability manifest/context; consultation proof relies on consulted_at.

decisions.decision: Bind tests to evidence hash, draft hash and a material configuration hash; publication requires all current.
decisions.why: Earlier passed tests could authorize changed inputs (review finding).
decisions.tradeoffs: Any runtime/provider/connection/config change makes tests stale and blocks an in-flight test task (candidate() raises 409).

decisions.decision: Reuse knowledge.guard/apply with native readback for publication.
decisions.why: Native CAS, immutable knowledge_versions and queued runtime refresh already exist.
decisions.tradeoffs: Requires idle bot and handed-back computer; publish without enable actively removes the skill from enabled_skills.

decisions.decision: Expected-revision CAS on every owner mutation plus Idempotency-Key receipts on start/control/test/publish.
decisions.why: UI refresh/reconnect must not create duplicate recordings/tests/publications.
decisions.tradeoffs: Frequent 409 'Reload' errors during polling-driven UI; owner_receipts growth (one per private barrier).

decisions.decision: 7-day default retention with Keep pin; delete/expiry purge via retrying background job; tombstone rows.
decisions.why: Plan's retention defaults; published skill must not depend on recording.
decisions.tradeoffs: Purge depends on reaching the bot runtime; tombstones keep hashes/skill_name.

invariants.text: At most one active capture session per bot.
invariants.enforcement: Partial unique index on bot_id for active states plus an explicit check under the bot lock at creation.

invariants.text: Only accepted input from the bound viewer/epoch while recording is retained.
invariants.enforcement: Observer runs on gate output; Capture.observe checks state, viewer, admitted epoch and heartbeat under capture.lock.

invariants.text: No frame from an earlier generation (e.g. before a privacy pause) is retained.
invariants.enforcement: Every transition/pause bumps generation; frame() appends only if generation matches and state is recording.
ClientCutText parsed and replaced by an 'omitted' event.

invariants.text: Retained sequence is contiguous; ready only after the whole tail persisted.
invariants.enforcement: Seq gap raises 502; ready state applied only when last event seq == runtime seq and revisions match.

invariants.text: Manifest rows only reference verified objects.
Private payloads at rest are encrypted.
invariants.enforcement: encode()/encrypt() for columns; cipher().encrypt for objects.

invariants.text: Generation output is applied only if still requested for the same evidence.
invariants.enforcement: UPDATE guarded by job_token, evidence_hash and state.

invariants.text: A candidate is visible only to its own test task (not peers) and only while configuration is unchanged.
invariants.enforcement: candidate() joins by task_id and bot; manifest skips peer views; config_hash check.

invariants.text: Publication only for the current consulted, completed, owner-verified candidate with matching native CAS and readback.
invariants.enforcement: publish() checks, knowledge.apply expected_hash, readback sha compare.

invariants.text: Owner mutations are serialized per session.
invariants.enforcement: require() takes FOR UPDATE and compares expected revision.

invariants.text: Capture control at the runtime is idempotent per revision.
invariants.enforcement: Same revision + same action returns status; different action 409; non-consecutive revision 409.

failures.text: Runtime/adapter restart loses the volatile buffer; collector sees another/no session and marks interrupted; retained prefix remains reviewable.
Storage/DB failure in collect: maintain records an error; runtime heartbeat lapses after 15 s so next input pauses capture.
Unsupported RFB message: capture pauses ('unsupported observation'); the parser stays wedged for that connection until reconnect.
Screen capture failure pauses capture with 'retained prefix only'.
Buffer limits (8 MiB unacked / 256 MiB total) pause capture.
Provider failure/invalid output: one repair turn, max_tokens->max_completion_tokens retry on structured 400, 100 KB/120 s caps; job failed with visible reason; stale running jobs reaped after 4 min.
Configuration change during a test: candidate() raises 409 wherever manifest is computed, so the test task's context/tool calls fail; owner must prepare a fresh test.
Native readback mismatch on publish returns 502 and rolls back DB changes while the native file may already be written; a retry replays (same-content write returns replayed).

Deletion/expiry purge requires a reachable runtime: native.request raises (503) before object deletion and the bare except swallows it, so rows stay 'deleting' and objects persist until the runtime is reachable.
A session left in 'finalizing' while the runtime is unreachable never expires (finalizing excluded from expiry) and can only be discarded through the runtime.
Unpinning (Use seven-day expiry) does not reset expires_at, so an older session expires on the next tick.

security.text: Private input: Secure input waits for the server-acknowledged barrier and aborts if refused; barrier pauses capture, bumps generation and stores only a generic 'private step' marker (no value, length or keys).

Ordinary keyboard typing while recording is retained as keysyms and summarized into 'Observed typed keys' text that pre-fills the evidence box; unless the owner edits it, typed values are sent to the provider.
Secrets in frames: full-screen thumbnails (1440x1000) can contain secrets; no automatic redaction; UI warns owners to exclude frames.
Clipboard payloads are dropped at parse time.
Encryption at rest with Fernet (CONFIG_ENCRYPTION_KEY) for goal, evidence, drafts, revisions, candidate, checks, reports and MinIO chunks; frame endpoint sends Cache-Control: no-store.
Test inputs and checks are also embedded in the plaintext test task prompt (tasks.input), so checks_encrypted does not keep them private.

Retention/expiry: 7-day default, Keep pin, delete/expiry purge objects, chunks, revisions and encrypted test fields; tombstone keeps hashes, skill_name, reason/error; published skills, test conversations and provider-side data remain (stated in UI).
Garbage collection deletes unreferenced teaching/ objects for deleted sessions or older than 24 h, at most once per minute.

Provider data: reviewed text, a canary and selected frames go to the bot provider's base_url with its decrypted bearer secret; no redirects; responses capped at 100 KB; prompt marks evidence as non-authoritative and forbids secrets/coordinates.
All owner routes require owner auth and bot-scoped session lookup; another bot's path returns 404; unauthenticated 401.
Consult endpoint requires the bot's own credential, an active attempt for the runtime session, matching sha256 and skill_view admission.
Demonstration text and frames are declared untrusted evidence in the generation prompt; generation has no tools.

order: Migration: sessions (revision, capture_revision, viewer/epoch, state, encrypted payload columns, job fields, retention) with partial unique active index; chunks, revisions, tests, publications.

Runtime: accepted-RFB parser on filtered bytes and a lock-protected Capture with revision/generation fencing, limits, heartbeat and ack-based batch; /teaching/control and /teaching/batch; keyframe helper; pause on takeover/handback/disconnect.
Backend session routes: start (input-ready check), control (idempotent, CAS, local discard before collector), private barrier.
Worker collector: ack poll, encrypt, stage, read back, commit manifest, interrupted on session mismatch; ready only after tail.
Review: timeline/frames, evidence freeze with size/frame limits and revisions.
Generation job: queue snapshot, single-slot worker, vision canary, schema validation/repair, token fencing, stale reaper.
Candidate tests: task creation, config hash, manifest injection, plugin consult route, consulted stamp.
Owner report and publication via knowledge guard/apply, readback, provenance.
Retention: keep, delete, expiry, purge, GC; UI panel in Computer and Memory & skills; Secure input barrier.
model: teaching_sessions(id, bot_id, revision, capture_revision, viewer_hash, epoch, state, reason, last_seq, retained_bytes, info_encrypted, evidence_encrypted, evidence_hash, draft_encrypted, draft_hash, skill_name, job_state, job_token, job_started_at, job_provider, error, pinned, expires_at)
teaching_chunks(session_id, first_seq, last_seq, object_key, sha256, size)
teaching_tests(id, session_id, task_id, evidence_hash, draft_hash, candidate_encrypted, skill_name, config_hash, checks_encrypted, consulted_at, owner_passed, report_encrypted)
teaching_publications(id, session_id, test_id, knowledge_version_id, evidence_hash, draft_hash)
interfaces: Runtime: POST /teaching/control {session, action, viewer, epoch, revision}; GET /teaching/batch?ack
teaching.candidate(conn, task, consulted=False) used by capabilities.manifest/prepare

pitfalls.text: Register the teaching router before the generic /bots/{bot_id}/{action} router.
Do not collect a prepared session (capture_revision 0) or it is marked interrupted before Start.
Refresh the liveness heartbeat only on acknowledged progress, not on every poll.
Fence collector state writes by capture revision so a stale pre-finish batch cannot overwrite newer state.
Serialize observation with privacy transitions and fence async frames by generation.
Never temporarily install a candidate; use task-scoped consultation.
Bind tests to evidence/draft/config hashes and require consultation for publication.
Disconnect/read-only viewers must not pause the owner's recording.
Cancel referenced tests before deleting source.
Secure input must type into the same RFB connection it fenced.
Iterate chunks; do not load whole recordings for a frame.
Handle structured max_tokens rejection with max_completion_tokens; an HTTP 400 is not proof of missing image support.
Hermes caches skills: a native write is not ready until the runtime refresh completes.
skill_view must never preprocess/run templates; candidate bodies must not leak beyond the task.
Chat-borne secrets propagate into task input/attempts; keep private data out of test prompts.
Takeover must drain admitted tools before input readiness; recording start depends on it.

covered.text: Parser handles 1/2/7/1000-byte fragmentation, drops clipboard payload, rejects unknown types.
Privacy barrier drops late frames and post-private keys; epoch change pauses.
Runtime control idempotency, revision skip rejection, drag boundary coalescing and buffer-limit pause.
Start idempotency/409 on changed body; start control; teaching-private-input pauses; stale revision 409; goal encrypted; cross-bot 404; unauthenticated 401.
Encrypted persistence, duplicate poll safety, finish->ready, frame selection validation, evidence freeze, delete purge of objects.
Candidate visible only to its task (not other tasks/peers), not enabled, no knowledge version; consulted stamp; report requires completion; config change fences candidate.
Draft name/frontmatter validation; cancel clears job token.
Generation with vision canary and exact reviewed text; encrypted draft stored.
Prepared session not collected; local discard then purge.
Heartbeat not refreshed by failed persistence; capture pauses.
Step summary coalesces typing and flags shortcuts/private markers.
Exact publication: stale evidence 409, native CAS write, idempotent replay, refresh_pending, one publication and version, not enabled.
Deleting source cancels active test task and hides candidate.
Read-only viewer activity/disconnect does not pause the owner's recording.

gaps: No test for expiry (expires_at) or the pinned/keep toggle.
No test of the real runtime routes (/teaching/control, /teaching/batch, teaching_frame) or the RFB relay integration; native.request is monkeypatched.
No test of generate_one failure paths (repair turn, max_tokens fallback, vision check failure, stale reaper, provider change).
No test of the /internal/teaching/consult route or plugin skill_view branch end to end.
No test of deletion when the runtime is unreachable, or of garbage_collect age logic (fake objects lack LastModified).
No test that publish with enable=false on an already enabled skill disables it.
No UI tests in the repo for Teaching.tsx (only fixture evidence under test-results).
Real owner demonstration and native installed-skill use are pending.

limits.text: Real owner acceptance not done; milestone unchecked.
At most 12 frames and 6 MiB of reviewed evidence per generation; 50 KB draft; 100 KB provider response; 120 s deadline.
Only OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions providers with image_url input are supported.
Capture covers keys, pointer and keyframes only; no IME/composition semantics, no DOM; coordinates are evidence only.
One recording per bot runtime and one generation job per workspace.
Listing shows only the 50 newest sessions.
Candidate is SKILL.md only; file_path requests are refused.
Recording cannot be resumed after a new takeover epoch or a different owner credential (finish/discard only).
Retained-size display uses formatFileSize which tops out at KB.

logic.step: Takeover and handback now pause any teaching capture before changing the lease.
The RFB relay records the admitted lease epoch and feeds filtered bytes to the teaching observer under capture.lock; disconnect pauses only the recording viewer.
Secure input first calls the teaching-private-input barrier and types only into the same, still-current RFB connection; closing the panel requests a privacy pause.
The computer panel embeds the Teaching panel.

security.text: Secure input is now blocked (with an error) if the privacy barrier cannot be acknowledged.

logic.step: Teaching publication reuses knowledge.guard and knowledge.apply (native CAS, knowledge_versions, configure operation) and adds a teaching_publications provenance row after native readback.
Memory & skills embeds the Teaching panel (mine=false).

failures.text: Publishing from teaching with enable=false removes the skill from enabled_skills via knowledge.apply.

logic.step: capabilities.manifest injects a task-scoped teaching candidate as an enabled skill (non-peer views) and includes teaching_candidate in the fingerprinted facts; prepare() reads the candidate instead of the native skill.
Plugin skill_view for the candidate calls /internal/teaching/consult; native skill_view remains for all other skills.

invariants.text: Candidate never appears in peer capability views.
invariants.enforcement: candidate() only called when task and not peer.

logic.step: Candidate tests are ordinary assignment tasks (orchestration_version 2, coordination_version 1, optional grant) in the bot DM; deleting/expiring the source cancels them through service.cancel.
Worker runs teaching.run alongside execution monitor, intake and routine loops.

flows.title: Teach by demonstration
flows.summary: Owner records a workflow on the bot computer, reviews frozen evidence, the bot's model drafts a SKILL.md, a task-scoped test consults the exact candidate, the owner verifies and publishes a native skill, and the runtime refreshes.

steps.text: Owner takes over the bot computer; runtime pauses capture, drains admitted tools and writes the input-ready marker.
Owner enters goal/expected result; backend verifies input-ready control via runtime GET /computer and creates a 'preparing' session bound to viewer hash and lease epoch.
Owner starts recording; backend posts /teaching/control (capture_revision+1); runtime checks readiness/epoch, sets recording and takes an initial keyframe.
Owner demonstrates through noVNC; accepted bytes pass the native RfbClientFilter, are parsed by AcceptedRFB and appended by Capture.observe; keyframes follow input at most every 0.5 s.
Before secret entry, Secure input posts teaching-private-input; the private action pauses capture, bumps generation and stores an omitted marker; only then are keys typed into the same connection.
Worker collector polls /teaching/batch with ack, encrypts each batch, stores it under teaching/ in MinIO, reads it back and commits the chunk manifest and last_seq.
Owner resumes on a safe screen, then finishes; runtime takes a final frame and becomes ready; DB is finalizing until the collector persists the sealed tail, then ready.
Owner reviews the timeline, derived steps and frames, edits the procedure and selects up to 12 frames.
Saving evidence freezes an encrypted, hashed evidence revision and resets the generation job.
Owner requests generation; job is queued with provider id/revision/model and evidence hash.

generate_one (single workspace slot) sends a vision canary plus reviewed text/frames to the provider, checks the canary, validates SKILL.md (one repair turn) and stores the token-fenced draft and draft revision.
Owner edits and saves the exact draft, hands back the computer and runs a candidate test with fresh inputs and checks; a DM task and teaching_tests binding (evidence/draft/config hashes) are created.

The test task sees the candidate as an enabled, task-scoped skill; skill_view goes through the plugin to /internal/teaching/consult, which verifies task, sha256 and skill_view admission and stamps consulted_at.
After the task completes, owner inspects actual results and records pass/fail observations.

Owner prepares publication (reads native skill hash) and publishes; backend rechecks hashes/consultation/verdict, runs knowledge.guard/apply (native CAS PUT, knowledge_versions, configuration), reads the skill back and records a teaching_publications row.
A queued configure operation refreshes the runtime so Hermes sees the new skill; response is refresh_pending and readiness is shown in Memory & skills.

discrepancies.text: Publishing from teaching with Enable unchecked sends enable=False, and knowledge.apply removes the skill from enabled_skills; republishing an already enabled skill therefore disables it, while the UI says 'Enable is a separate choice'.

The full candidate SKILL.md content is placed in capabilities.manifest facts (teaching_candidate) and therefore returned by /internal/context and injected into every turn's model context, contradicting SKILL-03's rule that procedure bodies are not in capability discovery and weakening consulted_at as proof of consultation.

Deletion/expiry purge calls the bot runtime before deleting MinIO objects; if the runtime is unreachable (bot stopped/deleted) native.request raises and the bare except skips the purge, so private recordings stay in 'deleting' with objects retained indefinitely. Review doc says deletion 'retries private-object deletion' without this dependency.
Test inputs and checks are stored encrypted in teaching_tests.checks_encrypted but are also embedded in plaintext in the test task prompt (tasks.input) and attempts.
'Use seven-day expiry' (unpin) does not reset expires_at (fixed at creation + 7 days), so unpinning an older recording deletes it on the next maintain tick.
State 'failed' appears in the expiry SQL and the plan's capture lifecycle, but no code path ever sets teaching_sessions.state='failed' (dead state).

Review doc says segment accompanies retained observations, but Capture.segment is never written into events, and the adapter passes capture.geometry itself as the geometry argument so the segment counter never increments.

Plan recovery matrix says a new viewer/lease epoch can resume via explicit takeover creating a new segment; code rejects resume/pause/private for a different viewer or epoch (only finish/discard allowed).
A session stuck in 'finalizing' (runtime unreachable after finish) is excluded from expiry and cannot be deleted (active) or discarded without the runtime.
POST /teaching/{session_id}/private has no UI caller; the UI uses the bot-level teaching-private-input route, which calls the private() function directly.
Teaching component's onActive prop is never supplied by its two embedders (dead prop).

Plan says generation/test/publication each have their own queued/running/completed/failed/cancelled state; tests derive status from tasks.status and publications have no state column (constant 'refresh_pending').
Plan says retries resume the same generation job; code marks running jobs older than 4 minutes failed and requires an owner retry.
Collector final UPDATE always overwrites reason with the batch reason even when the capture revision does not match (state is fenced, reason is not).

Every computer-panel close and every Secure input while a recording is recording/paused writes a new owner_receipts row and an extra 'private step' omitted marker; pane close is labelled as a private step.
UI captureLabel has no label for 'failed' or 'deleted'; Discard is disabled in 'finalizing' though the backend allows it.
AcceptedRFB keeps the bytes that raised, so after one unsupported message every later feed on that connection raises and re-pauses capture until reconnect.

isolation.text: Capture state lives only inside each bot's runtime container (module-level Capture); one recording per bot; other bots and the owner's host are never observed.
Candidate skill is isolated to its test task via teaching_tests.task_id; peers and other tasks never see it; nothing is installed until publish.
Recordings are stored outside the Library/artifact tables under a teaching/ prefix and served only through owner routes.

durability.text: Volatile runtime buffer -> ack-based worker collection -> encrypted MinIO object verified before manifest commit; ready only after the sealed tail is persisted; runtime restart yields 'interrupted' with the committed prefix.
Generation jobs are durable rows (queued/running) processed by the worker; stale running jobs fail after 4 minutes.
Idempotency receipts make start/control/test/publish replay-safe across UI retries; runtime control replays by revision.

security.text: Fernet encryption at rest for every private teaching payload; frame responses are no-store; consult requires bot credential + active session + sha match.
Privacy is enforced at the Secure-input path and explicit pauses only; normal typing and screen content are captured and can reach the provider after owner review.

concurrency.text: Owner mutations serialize on the session row (FOR UPDATE) and an advisory lock per idempotency key; runtime HTTP calls happen while those locks are held.
Workspace-wide single generation slot via pg_advisory_xact_lock('teaching-generation') plus a running-row check.
Runtime capture is guarded by a threading.RLock shared with the RFB receive loop.

workers.text: teaching.run adds two 1-second thread loops (maintain, generate_one) to the worker process.

tradeoffs.decision: Pull-based collection from a volatile runtime buffer
tradeoffs.benefit: No plaintext persistence in bot volumes; backend controls encryption and manifests.
tradeoffs.cost: Runtime restart loses the unacknowledged tail; collector outage pauses recording after 15 s.

tradeoffs.decision: Reuse bot's configured provider for vision drafting from the worker
tradeoffs.benefit: No new provider config; bounded, tool-less transformation.
tradeoffs.cost: Requires OpenAI-compatible image support; evidence leaves the workspace to the provider.

tradeoffs.benefit: Publication proves the candidate was tested against the current runtime/provider/connections.
tradeoffs.cost: Any configuration drift blocks the running test and forces retests.

tradeoffs.benefit: Retryable deletion and preserved provenance hashes.
tradeoffs.cost: Purge depends on runtime reachability; rows never removed.
